feature_notes.payment_cadence_proxy: proxy for usage/income derived from repayment cadence; NOT telemetry-confirmed battery swaps
feature_notes.telemetry_cadence_proxy: swap/usage regularity: 0.5*cv(reading gaps) + 0.5*cv(distance_km_since_last); lease from telemetry_readings, swap from swap_events (see scoring_service.py)
feature_notes.battery_stress_profile: swap_network-only: z-score of rider returned temp/DoD vs fleet average; 0.0 for leased_fixed (synthetic, assumed correlation — see docs/data-sources.md)
